decision.reason: The locked sources do not provide a finite coastal SLA representativeness bound or a finite GLO-30 DSM-to-bare-earth bound. Both apply to the intended land-exposure result, so no scientific binary cell is eligible under the fail-closed rule.

confidenceFramework.projectionTreatment: AR6 q0.167/q0.833 remains a separate projection interval
dependence: No independence is claimed between SLA, MDT, geoid, DEM, coastline, or representation errors.
Finite non-projection bounds are added by absolute magnitude; covariance cancellation is prohibited.
The Copernicus DEM 4 m LE90 product envelope contains random and systematic error, so HEM is reported separately but is not added a second time when it is below that envelope.
AR6 projection quantiles are not combined probabilistically with measurement or transformation terms.

sensitivity.conclusion: The interval classifier is logically fail-closed, but the selected real sources cannot supply every required finite bound. Choosing a maximum-total threshold cannot repair missing evidence and would only manufacture apparent binary coverage.
